classification: Local reference-host fixture using synthetic private values and real disposable PostgreSQL 15; no live-provider or deployed-host proof

source.binding: All nonignored tracked/untracked workspace files captured using a temporary Git index; excludes this evidence file to avoid self-reference. HEAD and lane index unchanged. Preserves the initial 13 tracked modifications and 31 untracked prerequisite files. No commit, push or deployment.

harness.isolation: Fresh owned temporary cluster; dedicated disposable database and non-superuser fixture role; per-case owned schemas; checked-in Drizzle migrations; independent SQL connections. No DATABASE_URL discovery.
harness.cleanup: Owned clusters stopped and removed by tests/run-local-postgres.mjs.

checks.note: Pre-final expiry-check run. Final entry source was rerun above; grant and answer regression source unchanged.

checks.result: passed via the sequential named SQL suite scripts

acceptance.concurrentCompletion: For token, password and synthetic identity, independent SQL connections commit one encrypted item, one consent revision, one completion and one answered event. Duplicate separately authorized resume appends one original-job resumed event. Delivery itself leaves waiting.
acceptance.conflict: Changed private input returns fixed conflict; changed binding/item alias fails without an extra item.
acceptance.crashRecovery: Capture in a child process; SIGKILL after capture commit before delivery. Different fresh process with unavailable keys delivers event cursor 4; third fresh process replays the same answer. Counts: items=1, completions=1, answers=1, jobs=1.
acceptance.rollback: Actual SQL CHECK failures on captured/delivered session writes roll back ciphertext/lifecycle/consent or answer/challenge consumption respectively. Retry succeeds against the same original session.
acceptance.fences: Wrong actor/tenant/account/environment/purpose, native scope revision, destination/origin/frame, session revision, expiry, withdrawal, cancellation, superseded challenge/job, item lifecycle revoke and narrowed/revoked grant prevent capture or delivery.
acceptance.lockContention: Observed pg_stat_activity wait_event_type=Lock: withdrawal waits behind active delivery and cannot withdraw an already delivered session. Withdrawal-first cases prevent all delivery.
acceptance.selection: Existing-item selection uses the existing owner-grant CAS/check port and records the permitted-use revision before completion. Incorrect stored metadata and revoked lifecycle nonce deny grants.
acceptance.secrecy: Synthetic random private values stay in custody/fixture memory and encrypted rows; scanned session, grant, journal, challenge and answer outputs contain no canary. No child logs or key/plaintext IPC; fixed exception codes only.
acceptance.migrations: Drizzle Kit custom journal/snapshot plus generated schema-export SQL; one-time v1 migration replay and idempotent rerun tested in owned schemas.

limits: No independent QA campaign or native verifier receipt claimed.
HTTP/UI, payment adapter and delivery scheduling remain separately scoped tasks.
Host callbacks must authenticate and hold native authority stable through transaction commit.
A future permitted-use job revision is host-derived; answer delivery never supplies resume authorization.
No Handrail database/provider configuration changes, production/staging mutations, commits or pushes.
